description_en: Submits a job to generate A/B stream variants of a video for forensic watermarking
description_zh: 提交视频溯源水印ab流任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-trace-ab-job --input Type=OSS Media=oss://bucket/object --biz-output Type=OSS Media=oss://bucket/dir/ --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitTraceAbJob

fields.help_en:
The location of the input file. This can be an OSS URL or a media asset ID.
The supported OSS URL formats are:

1. `oss://<bucket>/<object>`

2. `http(s)://<bucket>.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/<object>`

In these formats, `<bucket>` is the name of the OSS bucket, which must be in the same region as your project, and `<object>` is the path to the file
fields.help_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为：

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:

`OSS`: The file is specified by an OSS URL.

`Media`: The file is specified by a media asset ID
fields.help_zh:
输入文件类型，取值：
OSS：OSS文件地址
Media：媒资ID
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The input video for the A/B stream forensic watermarking job.

The Object Storage Service (OSS) file or media asset must be in the same region where Intelligent Media Services (IMS) is deployed.

This operation supports only videos that are three minutes or longer. Using a shorter video may cause the API call to fail or produce no output
parameters.help_zh:
溯源水印ab流处理视频输入视频文件。

OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致。
提交视频溯源水印ab流作业目前仅支持3分钟及以上视频，视频时间过短会导致接口调用失败或无输出
parameters.name: input

fields.help_en:
The output path. Specify an OSS directory URL or a media asset ID. If you specify an OSS URL, use one of the following formats for the output directory:

1. `oss://<bucket>/<dir>/`

2. `http(s)://<bucket>.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/<dir>/`

In these formats, `<bucket>` is the name of the OSS bucket, which must be in the same region as your project, and `<dir>` is the output directory path
fields.help_zh:
输出路径信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为：

1、oss://bucket/dir/

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/dir/

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，dir为文件路径
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The type of the output object.
Valid values:

`OSS`: An OSS object.

`Media`: A media asset ID
fields.help_zh:
媒体对象类型。
取值： 
OSS: OSS文件。
Media: 媒资 ID
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The output location for the A/B stream job. This must be an OSS directory
parameters.help_zh: 溯源水印ab流处理输出OSS地址。需要注意的是，配置的是输出目录Dir
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The start time for watermark embedding, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 水印嵌入开始时间。单位：秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The total duration for watermark embedding, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 水印嵌入总时间。单位：秒
parameters.name: total_time

parameters.help_en: The watermark level, which specifies the embedding channel. Valid values: `0` (U channel), `1` (UV channels), and `2` (YUV channels)
parameters.help_zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: User data to include in the request. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024个字节
parameters.name: user_data

Data.description_en: Contains the IDs for the submitted job and the output media asset

TraceMediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset created for tracing

Message.description_en: The response message. A value of `ok` indicates a successful request

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier for the request. If you encounter an issue, provide this ID for technical support

StatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of `200` indicates success
